contentPattern.structure: filter tab bar + (category + image + title + description) grid

suitableFor: adventure/trip teaser card grids that need category filtering
product or article grids with a category filter tab bar (All + per-category tabs)
4-up thumbnail + title + one-line description grids where cards are tagged by category
notSuitableFor: static card grids with no filtering (use cards-article)
long-form switchable content panels of a single item (use tabs-detail)

notes: Shares the WKND card visual structure of cards-article (image + title-link + one-line description, 4-up grid) but adds an interactive category-filter tab bar. Not derived by copying cards-article - authored with a leading per-card category cell that drives the generated tab bar (All + one tab per distinct category). Created because cards-article renders no filter controls, and the source uses a real AEM tabs (panelcontainer) wrapping identical card grids per category.
